_comment: Metadata for backbone/reference genomes. WHO strains from Unemo et al. 2012/2016 (J Antimicrob Chemother). ERR156xxxx from Harris et al. 2018 Lancet Infect Dis (PRJEB9227, Euro-GASP). ERR3851xxx from Pinto et al. 2020-2021 (PRJEB36482, PTGonoNet/INSA).

WHOF_genomic.label: WHO F
WHOF_genomic.notes: WHO 2012 panel. Fully susceptible control. Used as susceptibility benchmark.

WHOG_genomic.label: WHO G
WHOG_genomic.notes: WHO 2012 panel. ST1901 globally dominant lineage.

WHOK_genomic.label: WHO K
WHOK_genomic.notes: WHO 2012 panel. High-level azithromycin resistance via 23S rRNA A2059G.

WHOL_genomic.label: WHO L
WHOL_genomic.resistance_profile: rCIP, rTET, rPEN, decreased ceftriaxone susceptibility
WHOL_genomic.notes: WHO 2012 panel. ST1407 European MDR lineage.

WHOM_genomic.label: WHO M
WHOM_genomic.notes: WHO 2012 panel. ST1407 clone; mosaic penA allele.

WHOP_genomic.label: WHO P
WHOP_genomic.resistance_profile: XDR: rCEF, HLrAZM, rCIP, rTET, rPEN
WHOP_genomic.notes: WHO 2012 panel. XDR strain — ceftriaxone treatment failure reported (H041-like).

WHOY_genomic.label: WHO Y
WHOY_genomic.notes: WHO 2016 second panel. High-level azithromycin resistance.

ERR1560803_dPEN_dTET.label: ERR1560803 (PT13_031)
ERR1560803_dPEN_dTET.resistance_profile: Decreased penicillin susceptibility, decreased tetracycline susceptibility
ERR1560803_dPEN_dTET.notes: Euro-GASP study (PRJEB9227). Strain PT13_031 — Portugal 2013. Harris et al. 2018, Lancet Infect Dis (PMID 29776807).

ERR1560856_rTET.label: ERR1560856 (PT13_088)
ERR1560856_rTET.notes: Euro-GASP study (PRJEB9227). Strain PT13_088 — Portugal 2013. Harris et al. 2018, Lancet Infect Dis (PMID 29776807).

ERR3851425_rRI.label: ERR3851425 (NGPT15182)
ERR3851425_rRI.notes: PTGonoNet/INSA (PRJEB36482). Strain NGPT15182, 2015, urethra, North region. NGMAST 7445. Pinto et al. 2021, Microbial Genomics.

ERR3851452_multiR.label: ERR3851452 (NGPT15124)
ERR3851452_multiR.notes: PTGonoNet/INSA (PRJEB36482). Strain NGPT15124, 2015, urethra, Lisbon Metropolitan Area. NGMAST 1407. Pinto et al. 2021, Microbial Genomics.

ERR3851478_rSUL.label: ERR3851478 (NGPT03004)
ERR3851478_rSUL.notes: PTGonoNet/INSA (PRJEB36482). Strain NGPT03004, 2003, urethra, Lisbon Metropolitan Area. NGMAST 18168. Pinto et al. 2021, Microbial Genomics.

ERR3851482_dAZM_dCEF.label: ERR3851482 (NGPT12001)
ERR3851482_dAZM_dCEF.resistance_profile: Decreased azithromycin susceptibility, decreased ceftriaxone susceptibility
ERR3851482_dAZM_dCEF.notes: PTGonoNet/INSA (PRJEB36482). Strain NGPT12001, 2012, cervix, Lisbon Metropolitan Area. NGMAST 2. Dual decreased susceptibility — clinically significant. Pinto et al. 2021, Microbial Genomics.

ERR3851551_FullySusceptible.label: ERR3851551 (NGPT17406)
ERR3851551_FullySusceptible.notes: PTGonoNet/INSA (PRJEB36482). Strain NGPT17406, 2017, urethra, Algarve. NGMAST 18197. Fully susceptible control. Pinto et al. 2021, Microbial Genomics.

ERR3851566_rAZM.label: ERR3851566 (NGPT09083)
ERR3851566_rAZM.notes: PTGonoNet/INSA (PRJEB36482). Strain NGPT09083, 2009, urethra, Lisbon Metropolitan Area. NGMAST 5649. Pinto et al. 2021, Microbial Genomics.

ERR3851598_dTET.label: ERR3851598 (NGPT17496)
ERR3851598_dTET.notes: PTGonoNet/INSA (PRJEB36482). Strain NGPT17496, 2017, urethra, North region. NGMAST 4261. Pinto et al. 2021, Microbial Genomics.

ERR3851600_rCIP.label: ERR3851600 (NGPT03017)
ERR3851600_rCIP.notes: PTGonoNet/INSA (PRJEB36482). Strain NGPT03017, 2003, urethra, Center region. NGMAST 282. Pinto et al. 2021, Microbial Genomics.

ERR3851656_dCEF.label: ERR3851656 (NGPT17422)
ERR3851656_dCEF.notes: PTGonoNet/INSA (PRJEB36482). Strain NGPT17422, 2017, cervix, Lisbon Metropolitan Area. NGMAST 18195. Pinto et al. 2021, Microbial Genomics.

ERR3851679_rCEF.label: ERR3851679 (NGPT09084)
ERR3851679_rCEF.notes: PTGonoNet/INSA (PRJEB36482). Strain NGPT09084, 2009, urethra, Lisbon Metropolitan Area. NGMAST 5335. Ceftriaxone resistance — clinically critical. Pinto et al. 2021, Microbial Genomics.

ERR3851796_rPEN.label: ERR3851796 (NGPT10049)
ERR3851796_rPEN.notes: PTGonoNet/INSA (PRJEB36482). Strain NGPT10049, 2010, urethra, Lisbon Metropolitan Area. NGMAST 1217. Pinto et al. 2021, Microbial Genomics.

ERR3851823_CEF_AZM.label: ERR3851823 (NGPT17420)
ERR3851823_CEF_AZM.notes: PTGonoNet/INSA (PRJEB36482). Strain NGPT17420, 2017, urethra, Lisbon Metropolitan Area. NGMAST 15589. Dual resistance — XDR profile. Pinto et al. 2021, Microbial Genomics.

ERR3851892_rSUL_dTET.label: ERR3851892 (NGPT17020)
ERR3851892_rSUL_dTET.resistance_profile: Resistant to sulfonamides, decreased tetracycline susceptibility
ERR3851892_rSUL_dTET.notes: PTGonoNet/INSA (PRJEB36482). Strain NGPT17020, 2017, cervix, Alentejo. NGMAST 11744. Pinto et al. 2021, Microbial Genomics.

lactamica_genomic.label: N. lactamica
lactamica_genomic.notes: Neisseria lactamica. Commensal species closely related to N. gonorrhoeae. Used as outgroup to root the tree.

mendinitis_genomic.label: N. meningitidis
mendinitis_genomic.notes: Neisseria meningitidis. Used as outgroup to root the tree.
